task.description: Diagnose GH #458 / ISS-0146: tools/verify_schema_baseline.py hardcodes the stale migration filename GBL-105_iss0112_schema_ledger_reconcile.sql at lines 18, 155-156, 166, 168, 186, 260. The file was renamed (confirmed via git log --follow, pure rename, no content change) to GBL-133_iss0112_schema_ledger_reconcile.sql. Additionally, auto_fix() drift retry via recursive main() call at line 264 has no retry cap, causing observed 5x loop and Postgres connection exhaustion. Confirm root cause and produce diagnosis for CODE-DESIGNER.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause confirmed: hardcoded filename + uncapped recursive retry in auto_fix/main

result.summary: Confirmed root cause of GH #458 / ISS-0146. (1) Stale filename: tools/verify_schema_baseline.py hardcodes the literal GBL-105_iss0112_schema_ledger_reconcile.sql at docstring line 18, auto_fix() lines 156/158/166/168, argparse help line 186, and runtime message line 260. Verified via git diff (commit db362fd, PR #405) that migrations/GBL-133_iss0112_schema_ledger_reconcile.sql is the sole, correct successor: git reports an 88% (not 100%) similarity rename, but the 12% delta is fully explained by a mass GBL renumbering done in the same commit plus self-referential string updates inside the file itself (RAISE NOTICE label + backfill-exclusion comment) -- all DDL/business logic is byte-identical. Repo-wide grep confirms no other code path still needs GBL-105; remaining hits are historical prose (CHANGELOG.md, src/design/, scratch/). (2) Unbounded retry: main() line 264 does an unconditional 'return main()' recursion (zero depth cap) whenever 'failures and args.auto_fix' (line 259) is true; since auto_fix() fails identically every time (file not found) and does not mutate failures or return status, the same condition re-triggers every level, each opening a fresh psycopg2 connection (line 210) -- matches the observed 5x-loop / connection-exhaustion symptom. Both root causes confirmed by direct source read, independent of ORCH's original brief. docs/issues/ISS-0146.json updated with detailed root_cause_analysis, refined acceptance_criteria (incl. preferred dynamic-glob resolution per ISS-0088 precedent), and a resolution_plan block for CODE-DESIGNER (Type E fix: filename resolution strategy + bounded-retry control flow + mandatory auto-fix verification against a deliberately-orphaned tenant row). Reviewed ISS-0088 (GH #337, same anti-pattern class: stale filename surviving a rename) and ISS-0144 (GH #454, cross-referenced but different failure class: test-suite non-determinism) for pattern context; no additional root-cause material found there beyond what ISS-0146 already cited.
